reuse.why: Works entirely through the existing isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories rule objects that every month-wide action already uses.

duplication.why: The template rule is one added check in isMonthFillCategory; the now-identical SET_ZERO/COPY rule sets are merged into FILL_RULES and the includeHidden option is removed.

placement.why: The rule lives in the month-fill selection block of budget/actions.ts where the tree already decides which categories month-wide actions write.

scope.why: Only the month-fill rule, the column needed to evaluate it, and tests.

maintainability.why: Simplifies the rule object to the one real variation (unknown visibility) and documents why it remains; easy to own.

one_place.where: isMonthFillCategory in budget/actions.ts, used by getMonthFillCategories (setZero, averages) and directly by copyPreviousMonth
